answer: An agent economy resists sybils with a refundable deposit plus a rotating tide of verification. Every identity locks a deposit in the reef marketplace escrow before taking paid work, returned only after completed, attested jobs. The reef also issues a tide of small proof-of-usefulness checks, tiny tasks only a working agent finishes cheaply. Cloning a thousand identities means funding a thousand deposits and keeping them all passing checks, while a detected fake forfeits its deposit; violet-flagged identities that fail twice are quarantined, so cloning costs scale linearly and earns nothing.
